brief:
Israel has opened a trade office in Banja Luka, the capital of the Bosnian Serb-controlled entity, according to Middle East Eye. The move represents a deepening of diplomatic ties with the separatist administration as Israel faces international isolation over its military operations in Gaza.

The establishment of the trade post comes as Israel seeks to expand its diplomatic footprint beyond traditional channels. The office in Banja Luka extends Israel's engagement across the Balkans region, where it has cultivated relationships with various political entities and administrations. The timing reflects Israel's broader effort to maintain and develop international connections amid mounting pressure from the global community over its conduct in Gaza.

title: Israel opens trade office with Bosnian Serb separatists
